lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(home): privacy as a feature; clearer words for teachers and parents

## Intent

Teachers want something to pass on to their head or data protection officer, but the new home page linked the privacy notice only in the footer. Privacy is a feature here, and the home page should say so. The words for teachers and parents should state plainly that no data about their pupils or child is collected.

## Key changes

- Under "Was du davon hast", a box "Datenschutz ist bei uns ein Feature" links the privacy notice to pass on to the school. On /features/ the platform point is "Datenschutz als Feature" and links it too.
- Teachers: "es werden keinerlei Daten deiner Schülerinnen und Schüler gesammelt".
- Parents: "Niemand weiß, wer die App gerade nutzt. Die Privatsphäre deines Kindes bleibt geschützt."

moved.why: The commit serves the privacy paragraph asked for here and the wording asked for a minute later in i239; i239 has no other commit.
